info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Domestic Payment Payment Details-spec
info.description: The Domestic Payment Details Retrieval API allows clients to access detailed information about specific domestic payment transactions. By providing a unique payment identifier, consumers can retrieve comprehensive payment data, including status, amounts, and involved parties. This API is particularly useful for developers building financial applications or services that require visibility into payment processing details. Typical users include banks, payment processors, and financial analysts looking to enhance their transaction tracking and reporting capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details for a specific domestic payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific domestic payment identified by its unique payment ID. It provides insights into the transaction status, amounts, and associated parties.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a specific payment for the payment ID PAY-300045 within the domestic payments context. Please provide all necessary information as specified in the schema.
